note: A no-maximum-hand-size static on a non-acting permanent decides the outcome. A turn-based action no spell or ability performs: its records are turn_action records, which build-corpus writes to no stratum (FR-036), so the effect model is trained on no outcome of it.
Damage marked and boosts are read, so the later kill or survival is learnable.
Megrim's trigger is the acting line of its trigger record and the pending discard event is read; hand size decides the next cleanup's discard.
